dom.scene: After dark in an empty public aquarium tunnel, she pauses during a walk to look up at luminous jellyfish behind glass. Cool cyan aquarium light with a warm path light on her face. Both hands visible below her chest, one lightly holding a folded blank brochure.
dom.outfit: A sleeveless fitted white scoop-neck crop tank, navy belted trousers, small spiral pendant and slim shoulder bag. Bare arms and a clear midriff; everyday personal outing, no work uniform.
